title: Human Cannon Blast
description: Aim oversized cartoon cannons and fire ragdoll troopers through explosive barricades, bonus multiplier gates, and comical fortress towers.
controls: Hold and drag to aim your cannon angle and power, then fire waves of troopers to smash enemy defenses.

zh-CN.title: 人间大炮
zh-CN.description: 魔性爆笑物理大炮发射对决：瞄准角度把整队小兵连发轰向敌阵、穿越倍增门轰塌堡垒，火力全开爽到飞起！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕左右滑动调整大炮发射方向，持续发射小兵军团击溃前方防线与敌方据点。
